[id 232] The passage states the disease “migrates to humans through mosquitos,” so the transfer vector to humans is mosquitoes. → A  
[id 233] Iwasaki was “attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog.” → C  
[id 234] The temporary restraining order requires release of those held more than 24 hours without a hearing, so to be held longer they must receive a hearing. → D  
[id 235] The listed nominations include Best Picture, Sound Mixing, and Original Song, but not Best Visual Effects. → B  
[id 236] The passage explicitly says “Some roads have been damaged,” while the other options are described as shut down, closed, or without services rather than damaged. → C  
[id 237] Palestine wants pre-1967 borders and Jerusalem’s future addressed; Israel, not Palestine, demands an ongoing military presence. → B  
[id 238] Massa was injured “after a crash during the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix,” i.e., during a Grand Prix. → A  
[id 239] The text says, “Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant,” so the police reported the suspect. → A  

{"answers": {"232": "A", "233": "C", "234": "D", "235": "B", "236": "C", "237": "B", "238": "A", "239": "A"}}
